about_the_game:
Play the first 4 areas of Bumpy Grumpy!

Frantic Frank is late for work!
Not only that, those crazy drivers made him lose his papers.
Now, he has to get to work fast or face being FIRED!

Don’t fret, since Frantic Frank can drive like a fiend.
Fly in and out of traffic with ease, flit through
lights, and grab your papers to save your job!

Features:
• Arcade perfect controls: Change lanes instantly, and thrill to tight dodges!

• Judge just the right moment to run the light or slam the brakes!

• Evade wacky drivers like Tail Gator, Speed Demon, Slow Poke, Sundae Driver, and more!

• Grab powerups to gain the edge like the Chain Mace, the Spike Plow, and the Turbo Gas!

• Keep your eyes peeled for letters and spell “BUMPY” for an extra bit of pep!

• 12 unique areas, each with their own crazy, enemy driver!

• Pick up your lost paper work and drive to 3 different endings!

• No Quarter: arcade precision back from 1983—tough but fair. Perfect game balance!

• Points are life: Gain more points to gain extra lives and extend your run!

• Super Scoring: Get points for passing drivers, but gain up to x5 points for passing fast!

• Secret Points: Discover subtle points by cutting drivers off both coming and going!

• Global Leaderboards: Go for the high score!

• MAME ready: Controls already mapped, drop it into your arcade cabinet tonight!
